ND-2025-SB2265.aiSummary: This law lets the North Dakota Department of Veterans' Affairs borrow up to $3 million from the Bank of North Dakota and use it for a grant to help build a welcome center, parking lot, and related work at a veterans' national cemetery in the state. The money is only available after final project approval from the federal veterans cemetery office, and the department must ask for money later to repay the loan if it uses it. The group that gets the grant must report how the funds are used, and the department must pass that report along and update lawmakers on the project.
